reviews.review_description: The quoting process was by far the best and easiest out of all the companies I had dealings with.They gave me a fair price for exactly what I was looking for, no dramas at all. During the lead up to installation I was kept in the loop via email as to what was happening in regard to all the dealings western power and synergy. I didn’t have to do anything. On the day of installation the guys were on time polite and did a great job, no problems at all.After sales service was off the chart, fantastic.Great company in my opinion.Thanks again Stuart and the team at Koala Solar

I recently decided to install a solar + battery system thanks to the federal and state rebates, so I shopped around and collected several quotes. Koala Solar immediately stood out from the pack. Their no-nonsense, straight-forward approach (with zero confusing jargon or pushy sales tactics) made the whole process easy to understand. Their quote was also more competitive than the others I received and I really appreciated that they use their own in-house team rather than subcontractors.Sean did an excellent job walking me through the options and tweaking the system to suit my specific needs. I had a lot of questions (and a few changes along the way!) and he was always patient, clear and responsive. Bri and Shyniah kept me in the loop leading up to installation day so I knew exactly what to expect.Stu (the owner) and his team arrived at 7am on the dot and were super friendly, polite and professional. They talked me through the process and kept disruption to an absolute minimum.  My power was off for only about 30 minutes, which is impressive given it was a full solar, inverter, gateway and battery install. The whole job was completed in about 3 hours and the workmanship was clean and tidy. Stu’s enthusiasm and passion for solar is obvious, and he even helped me get the Sigenergy app set up and enabled Modbus so I could integrate everything into Home Assistant - a big plus for someone who likes to nerd out on the data and automations!The system has been running perfectly so far. Despite the overcast weather, five days in and we haven’t needed to import anything from the grid - even overnight. I highly recommend Koala Solar to anyone in Perth looking for a quality installation at a fair price. Great, personalised service from start to finish.

We wanted to capitalize on the battery rebate by adding a battery to our existing solar system. The team at Koala advised us on our best options, providing clear guidance tailored to our setup.Having had a great experience with them during our initial 6.6 kWh solar installation on a single phase with a Fronius Gen24 in 2023, we felt confident going ahead with the battery installation, assured we were in safe hands with their ongoing support.We couldn't be happier with the outcome. The 16.6 kWh battery size is perfect for our needs, and the installation looks incredibly neat. We found the entire process, from the initial quote to the final installation, to be friendly, professional, and completely hassle-free.Highly recommend Koala for their expertise and exceptional service.

My solar system is going to be installed in February. Koala solar recommended me the three phase system which I think is the best for my house.Price is in the  Solar quotes recommended range and they are willing to keep existing 5kw panels and add 6.6 kW extra panels.

Two years ago, Koala Solar expertly designed and installed a Fronius 3-phase 10kW inverter paired with 30 x 440W JA Solar Deep Blue panels. Their recommendation was spot-on—the system has performed flawlessly, delivering outstanding energy savings and reliability ever since. So when it was time to add storage, I didn’t think twice about calling them back.The team arrived promptly at 7am and installed two 15.8kWh Fronius Reserva batteries with precision and care. The setup looks sleek, professional, and seamlessly integrated—a testament to their attention to detail. Throughout the day, the crew was friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely easy to talk to, happily answering all my questions and explaining how the batteries optimize self-consumption and backup power.Thanks to Koala Solar’s expertise, I’m now set for true energy independence—with a robust, future-proof system built to last. Couldn’t be happier with the results!

The quote came through with all the options I requested and was cheaper than other quotes I received.The installation went really well, the guys turned up on time and got to work right away.  They kept us informed throughout the installation process.  They were polite and thorough and did a great job of cleaning up after they were finished, despite the difficulty of the site access.  The whole process went much quicker than I expected.Once the installation was finished the guys explained how it all worked and talked us through how to download and use the App.

I had a great experience using Koala solar for both my panel, Tesla EV wall charger and battery installation. Excellent value and communication throughout. Very smooth and professional installation. I highly recommend.

We found Koala Solar online and the whole journey from quote to execution was seamless! The koala solar installers who came by were also knowledgeable and they were able to complete the installation in a short time despite the rain.Their prices are also reasonable. I would recommend Koala solar if you looking for a solar provider.

The sales process was easy and never pushy — everything was clearly explained.The installation was faultless, tidy, and thoughtfully carried out, with the team taking the time to explain the system and how to use the app once it was up and running.The Koala Solar team was outstanding throughout, with excellent communication and all paperwork and grid connection handled seamlessly. A genuinely professional and friendly experience from start to finish.

The people were all friendly, efficient and courteous during the whole process from quote to installation. Their quote was very competitive and I was given options to consider regards our current and future needs. No hard selling , just good information given. All required paperwork was done promptly by them. Great experience overall.
i was very impressed with the communication from start to finish with a very competitive price.they turned up on time on the day of installation and left no mess when they left.

Once again, Koala Solar have lived up to their reputation as a friendly, helpful and efficient administration and works scheduling team. (they had already installed my Solar panels and inverter 9 years ago)Today, Koala Solar installed a FranklinWH aPower solar battery and A-Gate at my Australind residence.Couldn't be more happy. Answered all of my questions and left me feeling very content with the work and the product they installed.You won't get better service than what these proud people provide.Ian R

Quote was very detailed and Sean explained all the details and the process without being a pushy sales person.I asked for a site inspection before install to ensure there would be no surprises and they were punctual and explained the process on the day.Install day Again they arrived on time, were polite, worked around me when they needed to turn the power off, did a fantastic install, everything is labeled and left the place spotless.

I can’t speak highly enough of Koala Solar!Right from the get go Koala were really helpful and easy to talk to directly, as well as being the least pushy in terms of sales. I could always speak to them the same day regarding any queries.Out of multiple quotes I received, Koala were the most competitive and the only ones to get up on my roof and measured to check that my system would fit and confirm the minimum amount of panels.My 11kw system was a tricky install with several roof sections, but Koala did an awesome job that is neat and delivers great solar production. Importantly, they also use their own install team, headed by the company owners!I’d previously had a bad experience with another Perth installer that couldn’t deliver on what they’d quoted and I learnt how important it is to have a company that measures the roof area and also uses their own experienced install team!A month after install I couldn’t be happier with the system that Koala delivered. I look at this as a 25 year investment, and Koala gave me the best fit for me to future proof my energy needs.Thanks again to the office and install teams!

After months of e-mails, phone calls, requirement changes, rebates coming and going…we finally came to the end, and I could not be happier. Koala stayed in touch throughout the whole process and once all settled down gave me a quote and installation happened a few days later as they fitted me in on a Saturday.Cory and his team arrived a few minutes earlier than scheduled and about 6 hours later they were on their way.I had a million questions, and all were answered during and after the installation. The place was left as clean as before they arrived…I kept my old panels and the BYD batteries as it was going to a friend but everything else was gone and all I have left is a brand-new system that works as expected…Overall, I am as happy as….and would recommend (and have a few times already) Koala any day…could not ask for a more accommodating team.I replaced an old Fronius with BYD batteries and my new system is a Sigenery unit, 14 kW on the roof, 10kw inverter and 16kWh battery…which I might upgrade to 24kWH and a 3-phase EV charger.

This is the second time we have used Koala Solar, and once again the process has been smooth and trouble free. Quoting was a breeze, scheduling the job very easy (thanks Bri and Kristy), and installation was very professionally completed. Highly recommended.
While the quote did come a little later than others, they were the most competitive and answered all my questions.The installation was on time and had no dramas.

Very happy with Koala Solar, I would recommend them to family and friends. Quote, install and customer support have been painless and very responsive. Install was efficient and they left the site clean and tidy no complaints about workman ship.

I requested a quote 24/06/25, received my quote on 27/06/25 and everything was installed and up and running 29/08/25. Koala provided a comprehensive quote and promptly answered any questions I had. They managed all of the interfaces with my energy provider and for both the federal and WA battery rebates without any issues. Installation of the 10KW system (21 panels) , 5KW Inverter, Gateway and 16.12KW Battery system took just 6hrs from start to finish and the team explained the App on my mobile phone in detail - although the App itself is pretty easy to understand

Working with Koala Solar has been a great no fuss and pleasant experience. Right from the first quote from theirs sales Rep Sean and his honesty with regards to the pricing, product and the govt rebates and VVP information (both federal and state). No extra jargon and not pushy at all to sell you anything. Once we discussed what our requirements were and once, I mentioned I was keen to have the sigenstor battery and inverter system installed with a 10kw solar array, the pricing, quote and follow up from there were great. Their prices were best if not better than a few big name company.They managed to get me an install much earlier than originally anticipated (a couple of months earlier). I had a few questions about Bollards as the battery was going to be installed in the garage, and the customer support rep Brianna and her team were excellent in answering all my questions.Today was my install and the team was on time (actually ahead of time) and managed to finish the install within a few hours. The installer Callum and his team were professional, courteous and polite and always cleaned up after completing parts of the job. They walked me through what they were going to do and once completed, they showed me what was done. Once the install was complete, we had a discussion on how to use the system, including using the app and explaining the different modes of the battery and some advice on how to use it for the best outcome of a low bill. Overall the install was very professional and looks great. Now to count the savings.

Great team and company, what a pleasure to deal with!Adam initially quoted an 11kWh BYD battery in March when the WA Battery rebate was announced.  He was very accommodating and never tried to upsell, it was obvious with the rebate that maximising the battery for our home was our goal.  We settled for 2 x 11kWh battery storage with a combiner box in the end.Installed was booked for mid July but due to combiner box out of stock, this was delayed to mid September when the next BYD shipment arrived in Australia.  Bri from the office was great, from communicating of the delay to shuffling the installer schedule for the installation in mid September.Both Alex and Dylan rocked up early to set up the Batteries and the required electrical work, all done and dusted after 6 1/2+ hours, Dylan ensured the battery was functional and charged via solar.  The guys left the place clean and tidy, could not fault them at all.Overall, very happy with Alex and Dylan's work and BYD battery powering the house in the evening as expected.  Big thank you to Bri, Kristy and Adam for the great customer service.  Will definitely recommend Koala Solar to our colleagues, friends and families.

I recently had a 10 kW Sigenergy inverter with 18.04 kW of Aiko panels and a 32 kWh battery installed by Koala Solar, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.From the very beginning, Sean was my main contact and he has been excellent. I sent him multiple emails with lots of detailed questions, and he always got back to me with accurate answers. If he wasn’t sure, he would follow up with the right people and come back with the correct information. I wouldn’t say every answer was instant — sometimes I had to follow up — but given how busy the rebate period has been, that was completely understandable. Compared to many other top-tier installers in WA who never even responded to my enquiries, Koala Solar’s communication was outstanding.Other staff members including Bri and Kristy were also very helpful and professional. My solar journey had a stop-start moment when the WA government backflipped on their election promise about rebates. I initially booked and even had an install date, but I cancelled once things became uncertain. I expected resistance or pushback, but Koala Solar made it very easy. They simply said “when you’re ready, give us a call back” — no pressure, no hassle. Once everything was clarified, I re-engaged with them and was able to pick up right where I left off.The installation team led by Callum arrived promptly on the day of install. They worked efficiently, answered all my questions, set up the app, and explained everything clearly. They left the site neat and tidy, which I really appreciated.Overall, I am extremely happy with both the system performance and Koala Solar’s professionalism. At no point did I have to pay a deposit, and the entire process was smooth and transparent. I would strongly recommend Koala Solar to anyone in Perth who wants a high-quality solar and battery installation.
Great company to deal with, clear from the beginning and great after install support. 100% recommend.

How was the sales/quoting process? - Really simple. A call back and a great 15 minute conversation that brought me up to speed on all of the conditions and rebates and eligibility requirements etc. After getting some dubious quotes from some pop-up companies, look at their "suspicious" 5 star ratings, we did our research and looked for a reputable company that had been established a significant time and we happened to find Koala Solar.After rebates, $10,000 all up for 9.8 kw panels across two roof slopes, 16 kwh battery and 5 kw inverted all Sigen.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?Great. I initially had Sep 19th booked in for install, received a phonecall yesterday afternoon (1st Sep) saying they had a cancellation and wanted to know if I wanted it installed tomorrow morning!! (2nd Sep). They arrived at 6:30 and were done by 10:30. Really impressed with the blokes. Stu is the owner of the company and was present with 3 other tradies; one an apprentice, love that they are training up more guys!!! All the guys were polite and friendly and professional. Everything was cleaned up and I was left to play with the mySigen app and see all the power I was generating.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install, or show you how to use the charger? Yep. Stu and Jarrod stayed back and got me to download the app and log in. They ran me through a few things; battery, charging to battery, drawing from battery, etc etc. The app is pretty good.
Installed 16 kwh sigen battery system and about 10kwh in panels everything looks great 10/10

We have just had a SigEnergy battery system installed and have been engaging with various members of the team for a few months now and they have all been so friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. I've spoken to the office staff, the sales staff and the installers.The product is also top notch, nothing you can fault with this business.

Right from the start Koala Solar were very attentive to my enquiry and not pushy for a deal! Everyone is so friendly and the service is amazing, very knowledgeable. Always keeping in touch at all the significant steps and answering all my questions. Very competitive pricing for very good quality products. We shopped around a lot and the products were the highest tier for the lowest price. I would highly recommend Koala Solar to anyone!Thankyou for installing our solar.

Dealing with Koala Solar was aver simple process. The various solar options and costs involved were simply explained as were the potential savings for each option. The installation team were very friendly and efficient. All rubbish was removed and the premise was left in a clean state. After installation, the lead hand explained how the system operation and help me install the Sigen App on my phone. Excellent job guys.

This is the second time we used Koala Solar to install a system for us. The original 6.6Kw system with %Kw Fronius inverter still worked flawlessly but it was over 6 years old and we wanted to upgrade to a larger system with batteries so Koala Solar was the obvious choice for us.  The quote received from them for a 18Kw solar, 48Kw battery and gateway box was better then expected with the other installer referred by Finn from Solar Quotes giving us a quote that was about $10k higher for a smaller 14Kw solar,40Kw battery and no gateway system.  The people from Koala came at 7am as promised and the 5 guys removed the old system,  did a neat installation of the new system and left the place as clean as they found it  taking away all the rubbish, old panels , rails and bolts.  Including commissioning of system, showing us the features of the system and how to operate the system it was all done in under 8 hours even with a couple of quick showers during the morning.

I’ve used Koala Solar on two separate occasions and have been impressed both times, firstly in 2020 for a 6.6Kw system, Fronius Inverter and Jinko panels) and now for Frankin 13.6Kw battery.The team is professional, friendly, and easy to get in touch with, making the whole process completely hassle-free from start to finish.Their communication is clear, their work is reliable, they left the workspace clean and tidy, and everything is handled with great care. I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again and highly recommend their services to anyone looking for a smooth, stress-free experience with genuinely friendly staff."

The office administration team is outstanding—always quick to respond to my emails. The installation crew arrived punctually, discussed the ideal placement for the system with me, and carried out the installation smoothly. They left the area spotless and thoroughly explained how to set up the app and use the system. A fantastic local business that’s a pleasure to deal with—highly recommended!

With the federal battery rebate kicking in, I came to Solarquotes to find a suitable battery installer.Koala Solar had really high ratings and were also recommended by the actual battery company (FranklinWH) as one of their preferred installers. I chose FranklinWH as I already had an existing solar system and inverter that I didn't want to have to change or 'upgrade', and Koala Solar didn't try to upsell me anything like that either.They provided a very detailed and competitive quote, and were also very clear in all communications, especially with the WA Govt messing around with their own rebates/back tracking on the amounts and what systems were applicable.After agreeing to go ahead with Koala Solar, they found a slot for me very quickly.Cory showed up right on time to install the system. He and his colleague were clean and efficient and got everything hooked up and working in just a few short hours. He took the time to explain the app and how everything worked together.Would highly recommend them for any of your installation needs!

Cannot recommend Koala Solar highly enough having been impressed with them through all parts of the process from initial contact and sales process, to the quote and system offered all the way to the actual installation. The installation was carried out on time with the team taking time to explain all parts of the system, and ensuring the site was left in perfect order.

Koala Solar installed our rooftop solar system with Fronius inverter in 2023. In July 2025 we got them to install a 13.8kWhr BYD battery storage under the recently-introduced WA rebate system. Their quote was competitive and they kept us informed of progress with the WA and Federal Government rebates. The crew arrived on site on time, and the installation, set-up and testing was completed quickly and professionally. We are quite happy to recommend Koala Solar for their professional advice, customer service and workmanship.

Second time we have used koala solar, with a second battery installed today and previously a battery and 15 kw of panels. Great service and installed quickly neatly and efficiently. More than happy with the install and the customer service from the team in the office. Would happily use again.

We'd highly recommend Koala Solar. Both the sales and installation teams were professional, knowledgeable and honest.  They really know their stuff, and are friendly and punctual. The team were extremely helpful, and provided a detailed explanation of our new battery.

Had a fantastic experience with this solar power company! From start to finish, the team was punctual, professional, and incredibly efficient. They installed my 6.6kW system in just a few hours, and everything went off without a hitch.The inverter was installed in my very cluttered garage, but the team not only managed the job with no complaints—they actually left the area cleaner than it was before they arrived! They cleaned up after themselves thoroughly and took all their rubbish with them. If it weren't for the shiny new panels on my roof, you wouldn't even know they'd been here.Now I'm enjoying free power and couldn't be happier. Thanks so much, guys! Great work all around.

The quoting process was fantastic. Sean took the time to explain the options and quoted a system that would best suit our requirements.Booking the installation was seamless and I was provided reminders leading up to the scheduled installation day.The team that undertook the system installation were awesome. Their workmanship is excellent and they were very neat and tidy.Overall I am extremely happy with Koala Solar.

Worked hard on a rainy day to get the job done. Put up with my annoying questions and gave good handover advice. This was a word of mouth recommendation and I would also recommend using them. Stuart and team were very professional.

Very happy with the service provided by Koala solar. From the detailed quote and competitive price prepared by Adam to the regular updates and bookings details provided by Bri. During the installation the Koala team were very professional, courteous and efficient. The quality of workmanship was excellent plus they were very tidy onsite. After the install they showed me how to use the Fronius inverter app and gave me tips on electricity usage. So happy with the overall experience and have no hesitation in recommending Koala Solar to my friends and family.

We had koala solar out to discuss putting solar onto our house.Very happy with their knowledge and professionalism, they were just fantastic.They gave us a quote, and 2 weeks later we had it fitted.Highly recommend these guys to anyone.Thank you guys

Did exactly what they said they would do without fuss. Installers turned up on time and did what they said they would do quickly and efficiently without significant problems. Went to offer them coffee at smoko but they were almost finished.Cannot comment on value for money or quality of system yet but seem to perform to specifications.Lost a star on customer service because the  Feronius app is very unstable. I keep having to reset it and the videos I was referred to did not explain resetting adequately. I had to improvise and rest every few days. Not Koala's fault but the system is the one Koala supply.Koala's customer Service themselves were very good and very responsive. Bri, their front of office and co-ordinator is excellent and easy to talk to. They didn't make the videos but they do supply the inverter.

Once again, I've used Koala for another solar install (13.8kw system), and it was a pleasure to deal with Corey and the hard working team.They were very responsive from quote stage to completion, and completed the 3rd floor roof install efficiently, neatly and without any issues.Definitely worth getting Koala Solar to look at your next install!

Koala solar was easy to deal with, from the quote to the end install. They were not pushy in making you sign and answered all my questions.My father recommended Koala solar and I can see why. Great service, friendly and value for money.

Adam was really up front and informative. He answered all my questions, and tailored a quote that fit my requirements. The price was far better than some other reputable competitors for the exact same system. No upfront deposit requirement also felt safe.Installation went flawlessly, The installer was freindly and disruption was kept to a minimum, the whole job took around 4.5-5 hoursAfter install support also was top notch. I emailed the company a couple of hours after install as I wanted to hook my system up to home assistant server, and they replied with the information i required within 20 mins.Overall I am very happy with the install and the level of customer support. I am now looking to get a battery install and I will most definitely be going back to these guys.

The quote process was super quick and easy. They didnt try and sell me the most expensive package available and asked where i was comfortable price wise and we went from there. They managed to fit me in a lot earlier than we had scheduled which was perfect for me.On instal day they showed up exactly when they said they would and both installers were great to deal with, they got stuck in straight away and told me what to expect throughout the day.The tidied everything up when they left and actually left the garage cleaner than before they came. They also did a great job covering up a hole I had in the brickwork from an old air con system which I was really happy with!Before they left they set me up on the Fronius app and made sure it worked so i could track usage.Would recommend Koala every time!

The installers were on time, polite and able to answer all my questions. They explained the system and the app and waited until I was comfortable with it all. The installation went well and all looks good. Bring on the free power.

From the first phone call, everyone we interacted with was attentive and respectful. The onsite visit allowed for us to ask questions,  clarify our needs and determine the best configuration for what we wanted to achieve. There was no pressure during the process. The electronic quote system was clear and easy to use. The installers were punctual, organised, professional and polite. They communicated well and ensured we understood how the system operated and the app worked before they left. The installation was not invasive in any way. They were tidy and cleaned up after themselves.

Koala Solar came recommended to me by a friend and my experience with them has been flawless in every aspect from the initial advice on the most appropriate system for my home to the installation and advice on operation/monitoring of the system.Koala have taken all the hassle out of the solar installation for me and I'm more than happy with the quality of my new system and quality of the installation. The installation was completed within a few hours and the team engaged with me throughout and answered any questions I had.I will not hesitate to engage Koala again for any upgrade to my system in future.
Such a seamless and easy process from obtaining a quote right through to the installation. Everything was super organised and we couldn’t be more satisfied with our new solar panels.

We were put in touch with Koala Solar through the recommendation of SolarQuotes. Adam came out to our place to give us a quote. We found him to be knowledgeable and reliable. The system he recommended for us fitted our needs and preferences. We had some questions subsequent to his visit, and he proved to be very responsive to all our questions and concerns. Although the wait to have the system installed took a little time, the staff at Solar kept us well informed all through the process. On the day of the installation, the technicians turned up on time and were extremely polite and friendly. We are happy with their service attitude.

I am very happy with the service & price from Koala Solar. I would recommend them without a doubt. Very helpful and courteous at all times & always happy to answer any queries I may have had.  Thank you to the team.
From the moment I called Koala for a quote, to completed installation they process has been smooth and they've been very helpful answering all my questions. Would highly recommend to others.

From my first contact with Koala Solar, I felt confident I was finally getting the right information about solar energy. Before that, I had been overwhelmed by varying details and prices from other sources. Koala Solar took the time to explain a suitable option, along with two variants at different price points. When I called back later for clarification, they patiently and thoroughly explained everything, helping me make an informed decision.The installation process was outstanding. Koala Solar arrived on time, as promised, and took the time to walk me through the entire system. The work area was left spotless, and the installers were punctual, polite, and tidy.It's refreshing to work with a local, family-run business that offers excellent service.

This week koala solar installed our new solar system and we couldn’t be happier!From the moment we first contacted koala solar and asked them to come out to look at our roof structure and discuss positioning of the battery and inverter, which they did (something that other installers either won’t do or winge about doing!) through to the actual day of installation, we were impressed! Nothing was too difficult and the team worked professionally and courteously and left our house clean and tidy.We both love the app that goes with the installation and being able to watch a live data feed of how much power the panels are generating into our house, battery and grid.Well done guys. A great local WA family run business. We would not hesitate recommending this company.
The system was quickly installed (arrived 7am and left around 10am), they were on-time no problems and the guys communicated really well.

The guys sorted out a very difficult high roof very expertly when other installers would not do our house which was three stories high. And very good workmanship all over in just four hours, Very efficient and customer orientated.

Quoting process:  Took the time to listen and provide the information I needed to make a decision.  Being an engineer I had a lot of questions.   No pushiness, over specifying or over selling.  In fact recommended I not used certain elements or components and the reason why.Installation:  Got me an early install day much to my delight.  Installers were punctual, polite, informative, and tidy.Customer Service:  Took control of everything and made the job easy for me.  Answered my ongoing questions right up to install.  All grid connection and paperwork was taken care of.Things I felt I needed to do prior:  I ensured the roof tiles were cleaned prior ready to be covered by the panels.  I ensured I had spare tiles on hand to deal with any breakages.  I eradicated some wasp nests so the installers wouldn't be confronted on the day of install.  I checked for any potential shadowing that might occur where the panels were planned to go.  Found a TV antenna that might potentially cause shadowing, but that was not problem, the installed adapted in ensured the positioning took those issues into account.

Very informative and efficient in the sales and application process.Arrived on time on the day of installation, and explained everything I needed to know about the system. Area they were working in left spotless before leaving.
Punctual, efficient, knowledgeable and cleaned up after installation was complete.
Great work by a very professional team of installers, would happily use them again.Communication was spot on, very hot day, did a great job.

I came across Koala Solar when doing research on Solarquotes.com.au. From first interaction to the whole process of installation was amazing.Stuart and the team rocked up at 7am as promised. Throughout the installation process, Stu kept me in the loop. The site was left with no mess at all.Happy to recommend Koala Solar for your solar and battery installation. The team are amazing.
Very professional sales team, great communication and non pushy sales with competitive pricing,Installation was done quick and very happy with the quality of the workmanship.

From start to finish, Koala Solar were ahead of the compeition. In particular was the way in which they communicated. I must apologiese for the number of emails, messages and calls I made, but Adam put me at ease with each question I fired over.On the day of the install, they were solid, courtious and done quicker than I expected. I am now watching our usage on the app and loving every second.I look forward to engaging them again once we buy and EV and need a charger installed.

Received a phone call the same day I was referred by Solarquotes. Sean listened to my needs and submitted two formal quotation the same day. Their price was very competitive and they follow a simple "sign a contract commitment" with full payment on job completion. Bree kept me informed on progress and did all the liaison with the energy suppliers. The installation team arrived on the date agreed 6 weeks before and was very professional and efficient. I am a very satisfied customer.
Great team of people at Koala, provided lots of information to me. They made the process super easy and convenient. Great to work with!

Received quote within a few days and installation was booked within 2 weeks.Installers were very professional, arrived on time and left a clean and tidy site. Solar was working same day as installation.

The guys from Koala Solar arrived promptly and on time, were very friendly to deal with, were very helpful explaining everything (I had a few stupid questions!), were tidy and super efficient and finished the entire install of the 15 JA panels, Fronius inverter and a Tesla EV charger in under 3 hours.They even swept up the garage for me...bonus!!Koala Solar are a fantastic company to get your solar through in Perth...highly recommended :)

After researching and getting a few quotes. I decided to go with this family business and was told the owner Stuart will install the solar panel. From the start to finished Koala was very easy to deal with, no pushy sale tactics and showed up on time.
